stem.text: One end of a U-shaped tube is attached to a gas tap, with its other end open to the atmosphere. It contains water of density $1000\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$ and the heights of both sides of the water column are shown.

stem.alt: U-shaped tube with one end labelled pressure from gas tap and the other end labelled open to atmosphere. Water fills the bottom of the tube, labelled water, density 1000 kg m-3. Vertical dimension arrows are labelled 10.2 cm and 31.4 cm.
